memoryPolicyCustomText: Memory tools here are for recall only. When the user asks about earlier sessions, past decisions, or how something was solved before, call session_search (past conversations) or memory_search (stored notes) and answer from the results, citing the session and date. Never call the memory save tool: preferences and corrections are recorded in ~/.pi/agent/memory.md as described in AGENTS.md, and homelab facts belong in the project's documentation.
